Privacy Policy

Effective Date: September 22, 2026

Duyen An LLC, doing business as Studio 21™ Salon | Notary (“Studio 21,” “we,” “us,” or “our”), respects your privacy and is committed to protecting the personal information you provide when using our salon, notary, scheduling, communication, and related services.

Information We Collect

We may collect information you voluntarily provide, including your name, telephone number, email address, appointment and scheduling information, service preferences, transaction and payment-related information, communications with Studio 21, and other information reasonably necessary to provide services you request.

Payment information may be processed by third-party payment providers. Studio 21 does not need to retain complete credit or debit card information when payments are processed through those providers.

How We Use Your Information

We may use your information to schedule and manage appointments, provide salon or notary services, communicate about requested services, respond to questions, process or communicate about payments and invoices, maintain appropriate business records, improve our services, and comply with applicable legal obligations.

SMS/Text Messaging

When you opt in to receive SMS messages from Duyen An LLC dba Studio 21™ Salon | Notary, we may send messages concerning appointments, confirmations, reminders, scheduling or rescheduling, requested services, invoices, payments, follow-up communications, and related Studio 21 communications.

Message frequency varies. Message and data rates may apply.

You may reply STOP at any time to stop receiving SMS messages. Reply HELP for assistance.

We do not sell or share your SMS opt-in data or personal information with third parties for marketing purposes.

Your consent to receive SMS messages applies to communications from Duyen An LLC dba Studio 21™ Salon | Notary.

How We Share Information

We may use trusted service providers when reasonably necessary to operate our business and provide requested services, such as scheduling, communications, payment processing, website hosting, and technology providers.

We do not sell personal information for marketing purposes. SMS opt-in information and consent are not sold or shared with third parties for their marketing purposes.

We may disclose information when required by law or when reasonably necessary to protect our legal rights, clients, or business.

Information Security and Retention

We take reasonable measures appropriate to our business to protect personal information from unauthorized access, use, alteration, or disclosure.

Information is retained only as reasonably necessary for the purposes for which it was collected, legitimate business needs, and applicable legal or regulatory requirements.

Your Choices

You may contact us to ask questions about your personal information or request appropriate updates or corrections.

You may withdraw SMS consent at any time by replying STOP.

Changes to This Privacy Policy

We may update this Privacy Policy periodically to reflect changes in our services, practices, technology, or legal requirements. The current version and effective date will be posted on this page.
